reviews.shade: SKINFOOD Blue Chamomile Hyaluronic Mask Sheet 10ea
reviews.text: Great mask, cooling, used it after micro needling to help with cooling. Lots of toner in the package
reviews.zh: 面膜好好，涼涼地，做完微針之後用嚟降溫。包裝入面有好多爽膚水。

reviews.shade: SKINFOOD Blue Chamomile Hyaluronic Mask Sheet 10ea
reviews.text: This is one of my favorite hyaluronic masks because the chamomile really soothes my skin and hydrates it
reviews.zh: 呢款係我最鍾意嘅透明質酸面膜之一，因為洋甘菊真係好舒緩同保濕我嘅皮膚。

reviews.shade: SKINFOOD Blue Chamomile Hyaluronic Mask Sheet 10ea
reviews.text: This mask is a hidden gem and more people should try it out. The mask material is feels luxurious and hydrates the skin very well.
reviews.zh: 呢款面膜係隱藏嘅寶，更多人應該試下。面膜材質感覺奢華，保濕效果好好。

reviews.shade: SKINFOOD Blue Chamomile Hyaluronic Mask Sheet 10ea
reviews.text: This mask is very plush feeling and feels luxurious. I need this back in stock because I love it
reviews.zh: 呢款面膜好蓬鬆，感覺奢華。我要佢返貨，因為我好鍾意。

reviews.shade: SKINFOOD Blue Chamomile Hyaluronic Mask Sheet 10ea
reviews.text: Nice mask, but not as hydrating as I thought it would be. But really good enough.
reviews.zh: 面膜唔錯，但冇我想像中咁保濕。不過真係夠用。

reviews.shade: SKINFOOD Blue Chamomile Hyaluronic Mask Sheet 10ea
reviews.text: Super soothing and hydrating! Love to give as presents and friends adore this one. Doesn't have as much serum left over compared to other skinfood masks.
reviews.zh: 超級舒緩和保濕！好鍾意買嚟送畀朋友，個個都勁鍾意。比起其他 skinfood 面膜，剩餘嘅精華液冇咁多。

reviews.shade: SKINFOOD Blue Chamomile Hyaluronic Mask Sheet 10ea
reviews.text: Love this mask, blue chamomile very soothing and face feels plump and rested afterwards. Not a lot of serum left in pack compared to other skinfood masks, can reuse maybe once for serum next day.
reviews.zh: 好鍾意呢款面膜，藍甘菊非常舒緩，用完之後塊面感覺飽滿有光澤、精神咗。比起其他 skinfood 面膜，包裝入面剩餘嘅精華液唔多，不過隔日可以再用多一次。

reviews.shade: SKINFOOD Blue Chamomile Hyaluronic Mask Sheet 10ea
reviews.text: A nice, calming sheet mask. Lots of essence. I think this does help to calm and hydrate my skin. It will definitely be added to my regular sheet mask rotation.
reviews.zh: 一款唔錯、舒緩嘅片裝面膜。精華液好多。我覺得佢確實有助鎮靜同保濕我嘅皮膚。一定會加入我嘅日常片裝面膜輪換名單。

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
